description: Additional value-transformation filter coverage: a sha256 hex digest of a different input, a base64 encode/decode round trip on distinct inputs, and a to-yaml serialization of a list of mappings with mixed scalar value types. Output is the rendered file content under a '# file:' header.

input.config:
common:
  k8s_namespace: ns
more_filters:
  raw: k8s-handle
  coded: aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=
  subject: hello
  items:
    - name: web
      port: 80
      enabled: true
    - name: db
      port: 5432
      enabled: false
  templates:
    - template: out.yaml.j2

cases.expected_output:
# file: out.yaml
enc: azhzLWhhbmRsZQ==
dec: hello world
digest: 2cf24dba5fb0a30e26e83b2ac5b9e29e1b161e5c1fa7425e73043362938b9824
items: [{enabled: true, name: web, port: 80}, {enabled: false, name: db, port: 5432}]
